title: Can the intended newcomers recover from a traversal mistake?
matching_context: A traversal game aimed at newcomers. Flight is Kirby's example, not a required mechanic for every game.
hypothesis: A recovery opportunity may reduce disproportionate failure while retaining meaningful choices for the intended audience.
comparison: Observe intended newcomers using the same traversal task with and without one recovery aid. Do not coach them through every mistake. Preserve the game's intended emotional goal.
measurements: Meaningful engagement rather than only completion
failure_signals: Aid removes the game's desired challenge
Participants complete without understanding or engagement
Experienced testers are mistaken for the target audience
limitations: No test performed. Source context is beginner-focused Kirby on Game Boy, with falling still costing a life.
